messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: axis.ticks.x
parts:
Dear all,


I'm trying to get rid off the tick marks of the x axis only. It seems
that the documentation (February 24, 2009) is out-of-date in this
respect (table 8.1 features a axis.ticks.y that does not seem to exist
anymore). Instead, I found a guide_axis() function that could do the
job but it's too low level to be used directly. Any pointers?


p <- qplot(1,1)
p + opts(axis.ticks = theme_blank())


Best regards,

baptiste
--

messages.author: 7e54aa65e5af5819
messages.subject: Re: axis.ticks.x
parts:
See message
http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/msg/0ea252285ba64942

where Hadley suggests to set the breaks on the x axis to NA - e.g.

qplot(mpg, wt, data = mtcars) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = NA)
qplot(factor(cyl), wt, data = mtcars) + scale_x_discrete(breaks = NA)

--
http://learnr.wordpress.com
